fact: Malawi told the UNCAC Asset Recovery Working Group (3-5 September 2025) that beneficial ownership disclosures under the 2022 Regulations, in effect since December 2022, are made to the Registrar of Companies through the Malawi Business Registration System.
title: Beneficial Ownership Disclosure in Malawi
publisher: Malawi (Collin Chitsime), UNODC UNCAC Asset Recovery Working Group
